acts.map: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text, real people or copied website imagery. Tall vertical overhead papercraft diorama of a working rural craft museum, read bottom to top: green millpond and wheel at the foot, timber workshops and a bread oven along a winding open-earth route, then woven hazel shelters and a cluster of furnished little rooms. Keep the middle ground open and uncluttered for path lines. At the top, a clear broad courtyard beneath a flexible timber lattice roof awaits the towering room-stack Keeper. Teal hexagonal seams gather more densely toward the summit.
backdrops: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text, real people or copied website imagery. Wide fight background, floors 1–5: muted timber workshop walls, a distant mill wheel, sacks and tools arranged at the far edges, flour-white floor open across the centre. A few small teal hexagonal patches creep along low beams. Low contrast, no central subject.

Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text, real people or copied website imagery. Wide fight background, floors 6–10: subdued timber frames and half-built rooms, folded blankets on peripheral shelves and sealed doors along the sides, with an empty neutral floor through the centre. Teal hexagonal seams spread across walls and door frames. Low contrast, no central subject.

Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text, real people or copied website imagery. Wide fight background, floors 11–15: dim rows of shuttered furnished rooms and a faint orange hearth at the far edge, lattice ribs closing over the background. Dense teal hexagonal growth blankets much of the walls and roof, leaving a quiet open central floor. Low contrast, no central subject.
acts.boss: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text, real people or copied website imagery. Full-body, imposing Keeper of the Humble Past: a towering asymmetrical stack of small brown timber rooms on long jointed charcoal iron legs, shuttered square windows and a warm orange hearth visible in one opening. A broad flexible lattice roof arches over the stack like protective shoulders; teal hexagonal repairs stitch its edges. Brass pins mark the joints. Isolate the entire silhouette against a simple muted ground, with feet and roof fully visible.

Show the complete cone, arms and feet against a simple muted ground, with a powerful shelter-shaped silhouette.
